info.title: Hashing, HMAC & Checksum Suite
info.description: Give this API any text or binary data and it instantly returns its fingerprint under whichever hash algorithms you choose — SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, BLAKE2, CRC32, and more. It also signs data with a secret key (HMAC) and, most importantly, safely verifies whether an incoming signature matches — using a timing-safe comparison that prevents secret-leaking attacks. Language models cannot perform hashing: they produce a string of the right length and character set that looks correct but is simply wrong. Every webhook verification, idempotency key, cache fingerprint, or integrity check that relies on a hallucinated hash is silently broken. This API is the cure.
info.x-guidance: POST to /hash with an 'input' string and an 'algorithms' list such as ['sha256','crc32']. To verify a webhook signature set hmac.mode to 'verify', provide hmac.key and hmac.expected_signature — the response field hmac.matches will be true or false. Never guess or generate hash output yourself; always call this endpoint. The same input always produces the same output. Use input_encoding 'base64' when passing binary data. All keys are passed in the request body — never as URLs or references.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to do: 'sign' to create a signature, or 'verify' to check one.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Which signing method to use: md5, sha1, sha256, or sha512.

key.title: Key
key.description: Your secret key used to sign or verify. Never sent in a URL — only in the request body.

expected_signature.title: Expected Signature
expected_signature.description: The signature you received and want to verify. Only needed when mode is 'verify'.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether this was a 'sign' or 'verify' operation.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: The signing method that was used.

computed_signature.title: Computed Signature
computed_signature.description: The signature this API computed for your data and key.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: True if the computed signature matches the one you provided. Only present when mode is 'verify'.

input.title: Input
input.description: The text or data you want to hash. For binary data, base64-encode it first and set input_encoding to 'base64'.

input_encoding.title: Input Encoding
input_encoding.description: How the input is encoded. Use 'utf-8' for normal text (default) or 'base64' for binary data.

algorithms.title: Algorithms
algorithms.description: Which fingerprint methods to use. Choose any of: md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3_256, sha3_512, blake2b, blake2s, crc32, adler32. You may list several at once.

output_encoding.title: Output Encoding
output_encoding.description: How to display the resulting fingerprints. Choose 'hex' (default), 'base64', or 'base64url' (safe for URLs).

hmac.description: Optional. Include this block to sign data or verify a signature.

input_bytes.title: Input Bytes
input_bytes.description: How many bytes of data were actually processed (after decoding).

digests.title: Digests
digests.description: A mapping from each algorithm name to its computed fingerprint.

hmac.description: The signing or verification result, if you requested it.

siwx.name: SIGN-IN-WITH-X
siwx.description: CAIP-122 wallet signature for repeat access after payment
